paragraphs.text: These lines are very difficult for me to write because I feel like digging my own grave. AI systems are improving by leaps and bounds. From the early 2022 fumbling release of ChatGPT, which couldn’t correctly count the number of a’s in my name (it claimed two), we reached OpenAI’s release of math papers where an internal AI model solved many hundreds of previously open math problems. Aside from philosophical arguments, practical claims regarding the superiority of human thought, on grounds such as hallucinations or bias, increasingly appear to me like rearguard defence. For the bulk of today’s cognitive work, the writing’s on the wall: AI will take over.

The three factors driving AI’s dominance in the modern work environment are better performance, lower cost, and higher availability. The performance of AI models is rising spectacularly on all fronts: perception, knowledge processing and creation, reasoning, judgement, and autonomous action. In parallel, human proficiency in key information-processing skills, low on average among adults, is even declining among students. Consequently, AI systems are performing better than humans in ever-wider range of tasks.

AI’s cost is also falling due to huge investments and scientific progress. Successive generations of AI models offer superior performance at lower cost, with older models retained only for backward compatibility. As a result, it is making financial sense to replace or augment human labour with AI systems across an increasingly broad range of activities.

Finally, and most obviously, AI systems can operate around the clock, without the need for rest or breaks. They can also help alleviate labour shortages arising from demographic trends or skills gaps. Meanwhile, trillions of dollars in projected data centre investment through 2030 are set to bring vast additional AI processing capacity online.

As happened in past technological revolutions, there will undoubtedly be fierce resistance to the replacement of cognitive work with AI. This time it will be fiercer because, unlike previous revolutions, which transformed manual labour, AI challenges knowledge workers, whose specialised expertise, control over information, and decision-making authority afford them greater economic and organisational power. Governments will try to clip AI’s wings through regulation and taxation. Such actions didn’t quell past revolutions so there’s little reason to believe they’ll work now.

So what’s the fate of human thought? My take is that cognitive work will diminish. Thought will increasingly become a leisure pursuit, as hunting did following animal domestication, calligraphy after typography, woodworking after industrialisation, and horse riding after motorisation. Machines transformed much of physical activity from necessity into choice; similarly, AI will decouple human thinking from its economic purpose.

I’ll end with my thoughts on how to prepare for and live through this transition. My take is that building this AI-driven world, riding through the bumps along the road, and preparing to live a fulfilling and satisfying life in an environment where AI dominates cognitive work will be hugely demanding, stressful, and intellectually challenging. Such is the nature of revolutions. Consequently, we must keep pace with and capitalise on AI’s advances; be flexible, adaptable, and resilient; and build a purposeful and rewarding life beyond work. My challenge ahead is to move from making a living by thinking, to making thinking part of a life worth living.

annotations.explanation: 比喻做某事会给自己带来毁灭性后果，通常用于形容自找麻烦或自毁前程。

examples.en: By criticizing his own boss in public, he is digging his own grave.
examples.zh: 他公开批评自己的老板，是在自掘坟墓。

annotations.explanation: 固定搭配，表示进步非常迅速。leaps and bounds 字面是“跳跃和界限”，整体作状语。

examples.en: Technology has improved by leaps and bounds over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年里，技术突飞猛进。

annotations.explanation: 由动词 fumble（摸索、笨拙地处理）而来，此处形容 ChatGPT 早期发布时表现笨拙、不成熟。

examples.en: The company made a fumbling attempt to enter the new market.
examples.zh: 该公司进入新市场的尝试笨拙而失败。

annotations.explanation: 表示“除了……以外”，常用于引出补充或例外。美式英语常用，英式常用 apart from。

examples.en: Aside from the high price, the car is perfect.
examples.zh: 除了价格高，这辆车完美无缺。

annotations.explanation: regarding 是“关于”的正式用词，比 about 更正式。claims regarding 常出现在学术或论辩语境。

examples.en: There are many claims regarding the benefits of this diet.
examples.zh: 关于这种饮食的益处有很多说法。

annotations.explanation: on grounds of/that 表示“以……为理由”。此处插入 such as 引出具体理由。

examples.en: He was dismissed on grounds such as incompetence and dishonesty.
examples.zh: 他因无能和不诚实等理由被解雇。

annotations.meaningZh: （AI 的）幻觉，即生成看似合理但错误的内容
annotations.explanation: 在 AI 语境中，hallucination 指模型自信地输出不实信息，是当前 AI 的著名缺陷。

examples.en: AI hallucinations can be dangerous when users trust the output blindly.
examples.zh: 当用户盲目相信输出时，AI 幻觉可能很危险。

annotations.meaningZh: 后卫防御；喻指最后的顽抗
annotations.explanation: 军事术语，指撤退时后卫部队的防御，常比喻为维护旧观念而做的最后抵抗。

examples.en: Their argument for human superiority is a rearguard defence against AI.
examples.zh: 他们为人类优越性所做的辩护是对 AI 的最后顽抗。

annotations.explanation: bulk 指“大部分、主体”。for the bulk of 常用于指某一范围内的大多数。

examples.en: For the bulk of the population, the tax cut made little difference.
examples.zh: 对大多数人口来说，减税几乎没有影响。

annotations.explanation: 既可指接管公司、工作，也可指某个事物取代另一个。

examples.en: Machines will take over many repetitive tasks.
examples.zh: 机器将接管许多重复性任务。

target.text: From the early 2022 fumbling release of ChatGPT, which couldn’t correctly count the number of a’s in my name (it claimed two), we reached OpenAI’s release of math papers where an internal AI model solved many hundreds of previously open math problems.

annotations.translationZh: 从2022年初ChatGPT笨拙的发布——它连我名字中有几个字母a都数不对（声称有两个）——到OpenAI发布数学论文，其中内部AI模型解决了许多此前未解的数学问题。
annotations.explanation: 长句采用 From... to... 时间/进展框架，中间插入非限制性定语从句和括号补充，主句是 we reached...，句尾又有 where 定语从句。

structure.text: From the early 2022 fumbling release of ChatGPT
which couldn’t correctly count the number of a’s in my name (it claimed two)
structure.note: 补充说明 ChatGPT 发布时的笨拙

structure.text: we reached OpenAI’s release of math papers
where an internal AI model solved many hundreds of previously open math problems
structure.note: 修饰 math papers，说明模型能力

examples.en: From the early days of dial-up internet to today's gigabit connections, we have witnessed incredible progress.
examples.zh: 从拨号上网的早期到如今的千兆连接，我们见证了惊人的进步。

target.text: Aside from philosophical arguments, practical claims regarding the superiority of human thought, on grounds such as hallucinations or bias, increasingly appear to me like rearguard defence.

annotations.translationZh: 除了哲学论证之外，那些基于幻觉或偏见等理由、关于人类思维优越性的实际主张，在我看来越来越像是后卫防御。
annotations.explanation: 主语 practical claims 后接 regarding 短语，中间插入 on grounds such as... 分隔，谓语 appear to me like 表示“在我看来像是”。

structure.text: practical claims regarding the superiority of human thought
on grounds such as hallucinations or bias

examples.en: Such claims, on grounds like tradition or authority, increasingly seem weak to me.
examples.zh: 这类以传统或权威为理由的主张，在我看来越来越站不住脚。

annotations.explanation: drive 此处是“推动、驱动”，dominance 指“主导地位”。

examples.en: Several factors are driving the company's dominance in the market.
examples.zh: 有几个因素正在推动该公司在市场上的主导地位。

annotations.explanation: 军事用语，指在所有战线上，引申为在各个方面。

examples.en: The company is improving on all fronts.
examples.zh: 这家公司在各方面都在进步。

annotations.explanation: AI 能力的一个方面，指识别和理解感官信息。

examples.en: The AI system's perception of images is remarkably accurate.
examples.zh: 这个AI系统的图像感知非常准确。

annotations.explanation: 指系统在无需人类干预下自行决策和行动的能力。

examples.en: Autonomous action is one of the most advanced capabilities of modern AI.
examples.zh: 自主行动是现代AI最先进的能力之一。

annotations.explanation: 本义为“平行地”，引申为“同时进行地”。

examples.en: In parallel, the company is cutting costs and improving quality.
examples.zh: 与此同时，该公司正在削减成本并提高质量。

annotations.explanation: 常与 in 搭配，proficiency in something。

examples.en: Her proficiency in English has improved significantly.
examples.zh: 她的英语熟练程度有了显著提高。

annotations.meaningZh: 越来越广泛的任务范围
annotations.explanation: ever- 与比较级连用，表示“越来越……”。

examples.en: AI is being applied to an ever-wider range of tasks.
examples.zh: AI正被应用于越来越广泛的任务中。

annotations.explanation: 正式连接副词，表示结果，常用于学术写作。

examples.en: Consequently, the project was delayed by two months.
examples.zh: 因此，该项目被推迟了两个月。

target.text: In parallel, human proficiency in key information-processing skills, low on average among adults, is even declining among students.

annotations.translationZh: 与此同时，人类在关键信息处理技能方面的熟练度——成年人平均而言本就偏低——在学生中甚至还在下降。
annotations.explanation: 插入语 low on average among adults 分隔主语和谓语，使句子结构清晰但增加阅读难度。

structure.text: human proficiency in key information-processing skills

examples.en: In parallel, public trust in the media, already low among adults, is falling among young people.
examples.zh: 与此同时，公众对媒体的信任——在成年人中已经很低——在年轻人中还在下降。

annotations.explanation: 表示原因，后接名词或名词短语。

examples.en: The delay was due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 延误是由于天气恶劣造成的。

annotations.explanation: successive 意为“连续的、相继的”。

examples.en: Successive generations of smartphones have become faster and cheaper.
examples.zh: 连续几代智能手机都变得更快、更便宜。

annotations.explanation: at ... cost 表示“以……成本”。

examples.en: The new system delivers better results at lower cost.
examples.zh: 新系统以更低的成本提供了更好的结果。

annotations.explanation: 指新系统能兼容旧版本的数据或软件。

examples.en: Backward compatibility ensures that old files can still be opened.
examples.zh: 向后兼容确保旧文件仍能被打开。

annotations.explanation: 表示结果的常用连接语。

examples.en: As a result, the company had to lay off workers.
examples.zh: 因此，公司不得不裁员。

annotations.meaningZh: 在经济上合算；有财务意义
annotations.explanation: make sense 本是“有道理”，加上 financial 表示“从财务角度看合理”。

examples.en: It makes financial sense to invest in renewable energy now.
examples.zh: 现在投资可再生能源在经济上是合算的。

annotations.explanation: 正式用词，指通过增加东西来使某物更大或更好。

examples.en: They plan to augment the team with two more engineers.
examples.zh: 他们计划增加两名工程师来扩充团队。

target.text: across an increasingly broad range of activities

annotations.meaningZh: 在越来越广泛的活动范围内
annotations.lemma: across an increasingly broad range of activities
annotations.explanation: across 表示“遍及”，increasingly 修饰 broad。

examples.en: AI is being used across an increasingly broad range of activities.
examples.zh: AI正被用于越来越广泛的活动范围中。

annotations.explanation: 后接名词，表示不需要某物。

examples.en: The new device can operate without the need for a battery.
examples.zh: 这种新设备无需电池即可运行。

annotations.explanation: 常与 problem, pain, shortage 等搭配。

examples.en: The government introduced measures to alleviate the housing shortage.
examples.zh: 政府出台了缓解住房短缺的措施。

annotations.explanation: arise from 表示“由……产生”。

examples.en: Many health problems arise from poor diet.
examples.zh: 许多健康问题源于不良饮食。

annotations.explanation: demographic trends 指人口结构变化；skills gaps 指劳动力缺乏所需技能。

examples.en: The company is struggling with demographic trends and skills gaps.
examples.zh: 该公司正艰难应对人口趋势和技能缺口。

annotations.explanation: 由动词 project（预测）而来，常修饰 investment, growth 等。

examples.en: The projected cost of the project has increased.
examples.zh: 该项目的预计成本已经增加。

annotations.explanation: 表示按计划或很可能发生。

examples.en: Interest rates are set to rise next month.
examples.zh: 利率下个月即将上升。

target.text: bring vast additional AI processing capacity online

annotations.meaningZh: 使大量额外的AI处理能力上线/投入运营
annotations.explanation: online 此处不是“在线”，而是指设备或设施投入运行、接入网络。

examples.en: The company will bring the new data centre online next year.
examples.zh: 该公司将在明年让新数据中心上线运营。

annotations.explanation: as 引导方式状语，表示与过去情况类似。

examples.en: As happened in previous crises, people turned to the government for help.
examples.zh: 正如在以往危机中发生的那样，人们转向政府寻求帮助。

annotations.explanation: fierce 修饰 resistance，表示强烈反对。

examples.en: There was fierce resistance to the new tax policy.
examples.zh: 新税收政策遭到了激烈抵制。

annotations.explanation: 指与思考、学习、理解等心理过程相关的。

examples.en: Cognitive skills are essential for problem-solving.
examples.zh: 认知技能对解决问题至关重要。

annotations.explanation: 指主要依靠知识和信息处理来工作的人，如程序员、分析师等。

examples.en: Knowledge workers often spend most of their day on computers.
examples.zh: 知识工作者通常一天大部分时间都在电脑前工作。

annotations.explanation: 此处不是“买得起”，而是正式用法“提供、给予”。

examples.en: The new position affords him greater freedom.
examples.zh: 新职位给予他更大的自由。

annotations.explanation: 常与 rebellion, unrest, fears 等搭配。

examples.en: The police were called in to quell the riot.
examples.zh: 警察被召来平息骚乱。

annotations.explanation: little 表示否定含义“几乎没有”。

examples.en: There is little reason to believe that the situation will improve soon.
examples.zh: 几乎没有理由相信情况会很快好转。

annotations.explanation: take 作名词，意为“看法、观点”，口语常用。

examples.en: My take is that we should wait a bit longer.
examples.zh: 我的看法是我们应该再等一会儿。

annotations.explanation: 正式用词，指数量、重要性等变小。

examples.en: His influence has diminished over the years.
examples.zh: 多年来他的影响力已经减弱。

annotations.explanation: 指为了消遣而非谋生而进行的活动。

examples.en: Gardening is a popular leisure pursuit among retirees.
examples.zh: 园艺是退休人员中很受欢迎的休闲消遣。

annotations.explanation: 指人类将野生动物或植物培育为家养的过程。

examples.en: The domestication of plants began thousands of years ago.
examples.zh: 植物的驯化始于数千年前。

annotations.explanation: 此处指印刷术，与书法形成对比。

examples.en: The invention of typography transformed the spread of knowledge.
examples.zh: 活字印刷术的发明改变了知识的传播。

annotations.explanation: 指交通工具从畜力转向机动车辆的过程。

examples.en: Motorisation changed the way people travelled and lived.
examples.zh: 机动化改变了人们的出行和生活方式。

target.text: transformed much of physical activity from necessity into choice

annotations.meaningZh: 把许多体力活动从必需变为选择
annotations.lemma: transform something from necessity into choice
annotations.explanation: transform A from B into C 结构。

examples.en: Technology has transformed communication from a luxury into a necessity.
examples.zh: 技术已将通信从奢侈品变为必需品。

target.text: decouple human thinking from its economic purpose

annotations.meaningZh: 使人类思考与其经济目的脱钩
annotations.explanation: decouple 意为“使分离、使脱钩”，常与 from 连用。

examples.en: It is difficult to decouple economic growth from environmental damage.
examples.zh: 很难使经济增长与环境破坏脱钩。

annotations.explanation: 指经历并熬过某个时期或事件。

examples.en: My grandparents lived through the war.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母经历了那场战争。

target.text: riding through the bumps along the road

annotations.explanation: 比喻在过程中应对困难和波折。

examples.en: Every startup must ride through the bumps along the road to success.
examples.zh: 每个初创企业都必须在通往成功的路上经历坎坷。

annotations.explanation: fulfilling 强调有成就感，satisfying 强调令人满足。

examples.en: She has built a fulfilling and satisfying life outside work.
examples.zh: 她在工作之外建立了充实而满足的生活。

annotations.explanation: pace 指步伐、速度。

examples.en: It is hard to keep pace with rapid technological change.
examples.zh: 很难跟上快速的技术变革。

annotations.explanation: 英式拼写，美式常作 capitalize on。

examples.en: We should capitalise on this opportunity to expand.
examples.zh: 我们应该利用这次机会进行扩张。

annotations.explanation: 指能从困难中恢复或适应变化。

examples.en: Children are often more resilient than adults expect.
examples.zh: 孩子往往比成年人想象的更有韧性。

annotations.meaningZh: 有目标且有回报的生活
annotations.explanation: purposeful 强调有目的，rewarding 强调有回报、有意义。

examples.en: Volunteering helped him build a purposeful and rewarding life.
examples.zh: 志愿服务帮助他建立了有目标且有回报的生活。

annotations.lemma: make a living by doing something
annotations.explanation: make a living 是“谋生”，by 后接动名词。

examples.en: She makes a living by teaching online.
examples.zh: 她靠在线教学谋生。

annotations.explanation: worth doing 结构作后置定语。

examples.en: He believes that a life worth living is one of service to others.
examples.zh: 他认为值得过的生活是服务他人的生活。
